scope: Saudi building lifecycle research checklist for BOTH low-rise residential and commercial buildings, with per-topic differences marked. Broad stage coverage is not exhaustive clause coverage or automatic detection. Every item starts unassessed; no model observation establishes code compliance. Project applicability, edition and acceptance criteria require a competent Saudi reviewer and relevant authority.

building_scopes.low_rise_residential: First confirm eligibility for SBC1101-1102: the verified official description covers qualifying one-/two-family dwellings no more than three stories. Low-rise apartments, other residential occupancies and mixed use do not automatically qualify. Apply the confirmed residential/discipline route and project authority instructions.
building_scopes.commercial: Use the actual commercial occupancy, height, construction and systems to select SBC201 and applicable discipline families. Commercial is not one uniform occupancy. Mixed-use residential portions need separate scope review.
building_scopes.interpretation_status: Engineering evidence-planning interpretation of verified official scope/topic descriptions; full project applicability clauses and numerical acceptance criteria are not verified.
